features.title: Total memory, fully under your control
features.desc: Everything you see and hear on your PC becomes searchable. Locally, in many languages, with AI working on your memories.

capture.title: Silent capture
capture.desc: Screenshots at 1 fps with Tesseract OCR and the foreground app name. Dual-stream audio: microphone + system loopback, transcribed by Whisper in 30s chunks.

search.title: Semantic search
search.desc: 768-dim multilingual embeddings + sqlite-vec int8 (cosine KNN). In parallel, tokenized exact matching with fuzzy. Smart merge: exact first, then by score and time.

ai.title: AI on your memory
ai.desc: Streaming chat with tool calling over your memories: search, list recent, date ranges, stats. Inline screenshot/audio cards in answers. RAG and a daily diary.

ask.title: Ask the screen
ask.desc: Ctrl+Shift+A hotkey: instant capture + a question to the AI, streamed. With Vision (Gemini) it understands charts, layouts and images, not just OCR text.

privacy.title: Privacy by design
privacy.desc: Manual pause, auto-pause on idle and lock, app blocklist, PII redaction (cards, IBAN, tax ID, email, phone). Your data stays on your disk.

perf.title: Fast and light
perf.desc: SQLite WAL, hash dedup, int8 quantization, LRU embedding cache, VACUUM on shutdown. Backup/restore as a zip.

how.title: From capture to answer, locally
how.desc: Four daemon threads work in the background: they capture, index and let you search. None of it leaves your PC.

tools.search: top-K semantic search over screen + audio

items.q: Does my data end up in the cloud?
items.a: No. Capture, OCR, Whisper transcription, embeddings and search all happen locally on your PC. AI chat is optional and you enable it with your own API key. Vision mode (Gemini) is the only one that sends an image out, and it's off by default with an explicit warning.

Every screenshot (via OCR) and every audio segment (via Whisper) is turned into a 768-dim vector with multilingual sentence-transformers. Your query becomes a vector too and sqlite-vec finds the nearest ones by cosine distance (int8, ~4x smaller). A tokenized exact match runs in parallel.

items.q: How much disk does it use?
items.a: Screenshots are JPEG-compressed with SHA256 hash dedup. Audio is encoded as OPUS. Embeddings are quantized to int8. A VACUUM on shutdown compacts the SQLite DB in WAL mode.
Yes: manual pause (5/15/30 min, 2h) from the tray, auto-pause when you're idle or the PC is locked, and an app blocklist. There's also regex PII redaction for cards, IBAN, tax ID, email and phone.

items.q: Which AI models does it use?
items.a: For chat it uses OpenAI-compatible endpoints (Qwen3-235B by default, Kimi-K2.6 as an alternative) with tool calling. For Ask Screen you can use OCR + text or true Vision with Gemini. Transcription: faster-whisper large-v3-turbo on CPU int8.
Déjà is a PyQt6 desktop project. Join the waitlist for builds and updates. The site you're on is its showcase + account area.

download.step2: On first launch pick your language and grant capture consent.
download.step3: Press Ctrl+Shift+D to search your memory.
download.smartscreen: On first launch Windows SmartScreen may warn (app not signed yet): click "More info" → "Run anyway".
download.tesseract: Optional OCR: install Tesseract to make on-screen text searchable (extra languages selectable in settings).
download.devNote: For developers: clone the repo, create the venv and run main.py.
